title: Sign-in, session lifecycle, logout and safe return navigation
behavior: Accept normalized email and native secret, give one invalid-credentials response, renew valid sessions and reject expired/revoked/deleted identities at every domain operation. Better Auth replaces custom session hashing/cookies; preserve 30-day session life with renewal after remaining life falls below 15 days, immediate authoritative revocation and convergent repeated logout. A safe local return path preserves path/query and rejects external, protocol-relative, backslash-leading and control-character attacks. Login remains reachable with an expired cookie, so recovery cannot loop. Use an atomic shared attempt budget: login failure thresholds 5/normalized identifier and 20/trusted IP in a strict 15 minute window; success clears only that identifier/kind's in-window failures. Unknown IP skips only that IP axis, never identifier checks. Deployment must overwrite trusted IP headers. Concurrent attempts reserve/check budget under the same store rather than relying on request-local counts; budget store failure refuses authentication with a retryable message, without authenticating silently.

title: Registration and account-entity provisioning
behavior: Support planter, sending-church, network and explicit Discovery identities. Required normalized email, native password 8–1024 characters, display name and relevant organization name validate before effects. New organization provisioning produces that organization's Owner; planter onboarding produces one plant/Owner/Person; Discovery produces a profile without seat. Ordinary addressed invitations select only their advertised type/seat, never arbitrary user-sup plied grants. Apply REQ-IDN-030, a unique login identifier, one active seat and idempotent provisioning. Registration's IP admission budget counts every submitted registration attempt (including success, duplicate, malformed, beta/refused and concurrent requests) at 3/hour per trustworthy known IP, distinct from login; an unavailable trustworthy IP refuses registration admission with a retryable message instead of bypassing its sole creation axis. Store/query failures refuse before grant. Do not expose account existence to senders.

title: Beta gate and meaningful invitation-origin registration
behavior: Retain an optional deployment-controlled beta gate, disabled by default for the fresh target unless explicitly enabled in that environment. An enabled gate accepts a valid configured code or an addressed live pending eligible invitation; forged, unrelated, expired or revoked invitations never bypass it. Account type choices follow the validated invitation subject. Show sufficient inviter/organization identity for informed acceptance, with no gate secret or sender-facing account-existence disclosure. Revalidate token and gate at submission.

title: Development and managed-preview account switching
behavior: Retain reproducible development/managed-preview persona switching only for fresh synthetic allow listed fixture accounts. The server checks explicit environment enablement, supported fixture ID and intended environment before issuing a fixture session. Production defaults disable and exclude the action/surface; flags or client role strings cannot create production privilege. Never clone real/customer accounts into fixtures.

title: Seat, tenancy, capability guards and read-only affordances
behavior: Implement REQ-IDN-029 with one active account-seat constraint, typed tenant identity and fail-closed handling of inconsistent membership rows. Enforce authority on the server and in the write transaction, independently of hidden/read-only UI controls. Own seat, Discovery relationship, exact organization oversight and platform allow list are distinct contexts, never pooled grants. Subject/own-duty guards remain narrower than generic routine administration. Return bounded DTO s; foreign/not-found records cannot disclose another tenant through detail, download, aggregate, cache or assistant paths.

title: Account avatar upload, replacement, removal and authenticated delivery
behavior: Native self avatar upload accepts nonempty JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 3 MiB with generated private keys and verified type. Authenticate delivery through an account/version route; no arbitrary raw key or bearer storage URL is returned. Upload new bytes, atomically save version/reference/audit, then cleanup old unreferenced bytes. A failed row update retains old avatar and schedules orphan cleanup; failed old-byte cleanup leaves new avatar usable. Removal clears reference before cleanup. Account deletion follows REQ-IDN-032.

title: Email change request, proof, confirmation and security notice
behavior: Native self requests normalized valid different email with current-password proof. Keep one live hashed purpose-bound request expiring after 24 elapsed hours; new request supersedes prior. Confirmation requires the authenticated request owner, live token, current email/credential revision and unique target address. Under one account lock, claim token, swap login email, invalidate outstanding reset/email requests, append audit and old-address security-mail intent exactly once. Preserve account/Person identity. Login-email change does not silently rewrite independently edit able CRM contact email. Throttle outstanding/failed requests by current own login identifier 3/hour and trusted IP 10/hour, so target-address changes cannot evade budget. Delivery failure reports send state while preserving truthful request state.

title: Authenticated password change and other-session revocation
behavior: Require native current-secret proof for authenticated self, new 8–1024 character secret different from current, and immutable actor/current-session IDs from server. Lock account and compare credential/email revision; write new credentials, invalidate pending reset/email tokens, revoke all other sessions and append audit/security-mail intent atomically. Preserve only actual current session if still valid, report the other-session count. Independent password-change failure budget 5/own identifier and 20/trusted IP per 15 minutes; short/unchanged malformed requests validate without probing the new secret against the old before current-secret proof.

title: Mailbox password recovery
behavior: Return the same bounded response/latency class for syntactically valid existing/nonexisting addresses and mail failure. Each consumes the request budget 3/normalized email and 10/trusted IP per hour before lookup. One live hashed purpose-bound token/account expires after 1 elapsed hour; request rotates prior. Redemption binds account from token, checks live/unconsumed token and captured email/credential revision, validates confirmed 8–1024 character new secret, and atomically replaces credentials, consumes all reset/email requests and revokes every session. Do not auto-sign-in. Success remains success if security-notice dispatch later fails; provider/database request failures are bounded and observable internally without enumeration.

title: Settings modal, deep links, draft protection and section API
behavior: Expose only known authorized account/church/association/team/organization/notification sections as typed DTO s. Preserve direct section URL s/hash compatibility, back/forward, focus/keyboard access and dirty draft protection across navigation/dismissal; a simpler shell is allowed. Preference auto save reports pending/error and restores server state on failure; rejected explicit save retains the user's draft. Server rechecks section owner/current scope/revision and cached results key exact actor/tenant. Personal timezone and deletion/cancellation native entry points integrate here; restricted deletion sessions cannot load normal settings. Affiliation settings use the same exact-organization category policy as privacy.setSharing: teams maps to ministry_teams and activityPush maps to activity; shared_findings is the single released-health/NI permission. An omitted category preserves its stored value. A nonempty closed patch binds current relationship and consent revisions, accepts only actual same-plant Owner/Admin, and commits through the shared organization helper in one domain transaction. Organization roles cannot edit plant consent; stale/missing/revoked policies refuse without reset or partial effects.

title: Church profile, locality, timezone, inactivity and digest schedule
behavior: Owner/Admin edit plant name and independent nullable street/city/region/country/profile fields; validate trimmed nonempty name and bounded fields, IANA timezone, weekday 0–6/hour 0–23, inactivity warning/alert 1–365 with warning<alert. Fresh defaults are America/Chicago and weekly digest Sunday 16:00. Street is excluded from organization directory/oversight; configured locality uses the shared geography contract. Timezone changes preview future schedules/reminders; past instants, LocalDate deadlines and one-time appointments remain. Inactivity/overdue computations use church-local dates. Missing optional locality is not an inferred population/area.

title: Per-account notification preferences, cadence and self suppression recovery
behavior: Expose current audience's closed category/channel/daily-weekly cadence preference matrix and truthful suppression state. Save only the authenticated account's allowed preferences, with rollback/visible error on refusal. Self suppression-clear applies only its current proven mailbox and does not grant unrelated consent; enabled org push preference cannot override plant consent. Notification-owned scheduling/digest contracts provide actual delivery, including Sunday 16:00 default weekly digest. No private-care preference/nudge metadata reaches email or assistant.

title: Church creation, onboarding basics and account-person bootstrap
behavior: For a proven eligible account create one plant, Owner membership, all-OFF self-start sharing settings and one stable account-linked CRM Person in the domain transaction. Trim required plant name; allow partial independent locality. Repeated intent returns the same plant; simultaneous seat acceptance/creation cannot create a second active seat, orphan authority or stray Person. Account-linked Owner is CRM leader-stage bootstrap history, not proof of commitment/adult eligibility. Actual church creation enters Phase 1, with a once-only church_creation history variant from no previous plant phase; it does not attest an existing journey or mark readiness/reading complete. Retry returns the actual current phase without overwriting later history. A successful basics step cannot be reentered to provision again. Global canonical seed is separate from customer creation.

title: Leadership attestation, vacant-owner claim and prompts
behavior: Retain the yes/no onboarding question as ordinary CRM/ministry-role data. Yes visibly assigns the ordinary lead ministry role to the existing Owner Person, reusing its role/container or creating only the shown minimal necessary role/container; no whole-template import occurs. A separate optional selected Senior Pastor template fill uses the ordinary membership operation and only a vacant selected role. No leaves routine Owner authority intact and shows no fabricated lead. A separate operating lead is a real Person with ordinary role and independently accepted Admin invitation where needed. The selected role/import preview discloses assignment, preserves an occupied/explicit leader and never copies readers/private care. Source vacant-owner claim/attestation privilege flows are superseded; no target operation activates authority from the answer. Missing lead title never suppresses required evaluation/follow-up: explicit eligible assignment or Needs owner remains visible.

title: Journey declaration, launch-date setup, completion and resume
behavior: Persist basics/lead answer/journey/People facts and derive resume from them. Optional steps may be skipped; finishing stamps onboarding completion once and material source revision without claiming all facts are complete or generating an assessment synchronously. Existing-journey declaration is optional human attestation, separate from actual creation-entry Phase 1. A saved unsure/discerning/skip answer can complete that setup step but is not an attestation and keeps actual creation Phase 1. It never silently maps back to Phase 0; later explicit validated reasoned phase correction remains available. Native launch plan accepts no-date and cannot clear an existing schedule accidentally during onboarding; phase and launch writes are a single reviewed resumable intent if they cannot share the short transaction. Back/reentry cannot rerun finished provisioning. Missing facts remain visible after finish; no mandatory six-article gate for actual Phase 1 creation.

title: Discovery identity, associations and conversion to plant
behavior: Maintain explicit Discovery profile and scoped sending-church/network relationships without any organization seat. Seatless former Member is not automatically Discovery. Conversion by the proven profile owner locks account/profile, creates plant at Phase 1 with once-only creation-entry provenance plus Owner/Person and transfers only chosen disclosed relationships/sharing choices in one domain transaction, retiring the Discovery profile with history. Associated Discovery must resolve/leave incompatible association before ordinary first-seat acceptance; no automatic tenancy move. Race conversion, relationship edit and invitation claim under the same account lock and one-active-seat arbiter.

title: Seat invitation create, pending list, resend, revoke, expire and first-seat acceptance
behavior: Owner/Admin invite ordinary Admin/Member into their exact workspace. Keep addressed hashed purpose token, pending→accepted/expired/revoked, 30 elapsed-day expiry, at most 3 new invitation attempts per exact workspace/address in 30 elapsed days, persistent 60 elapsed-second resend cool down and one pending subject/address intent. Resend rotates token after current revision/cool down check; revoke/accept/resend race has one winner. Pending lists/sender responses redact account-resolution data. Proven existing seatless account may accept its first seat; new account uses REQ-IDN-030. Refuse already active-seat accounts, wrong mailbox, malformed target/type, expired/revoked/superseded token and incompatible associated Discovery rather than moving tenancy. Validate inside the claim transaction; mail retry returns the same invitation receipt.

title: Seat roster, Admin appointment/demotion and authority removal
behavior: Owner/Admin manage ordinary same-workspace Admin/Member seats under expected current role/revision. Protect actual Owner; deny self-promotion, foreign target, generic Owner removal and role changes that violate one-active-seat integrity. Joined date uses accepted invite provenance or clearly labelled original-account fallback. Removal revokes membership authority/sessions, retains CRM/account link and qualification/team history, clears access-dependent team leadership, and presents exact actionable-duty handoff to a currently eligible recipient or visible Needs owner. Closed/waived/deleted duties remain closed. Role/grant/duty/audit changes commit together, or return durable named moved/remaining outcomes; no generic success after partial hidden work. Removal is not account deletion/ownership transfer.

title: Organization relationship invitations across five subject types
behavior: Support five scoped subjects: plant→sending church, plant→network, sending church→network, Discovery→sending church and Discovery→network. A plant Owner/Admin initiates its link; one exact receiving organization's Owner/Admin approves that organization, with no delegation or all-affiliate veto. Each link has independent state/consent and typed matching subject IDs. Keep normalized mailable recipient, 30 day expiry, at most 3 new invites/address in the rolling configured 30 day invitation window, no duplicate pending intent and exact readable inviter description. Creation/response/resend/revoke validates current actor/subject/revision. Multiple independent valid affiliations may coexist; competing acceptance cannot silently replace existing links or consent. Accepted receipt queues notice to plant, retries converge and mail failure does not undo a committed relationship.

title: Relationship leaving, organization severing and association history
behavior: An authorized subject-side Owner/Admin may leave exactly its own affiliation; exact own-org Owner/Admin may end only that organization's link with confirmation and retryable notice to the plant. Preserve other affiliations and independent access paths. Append typed actor/org/subject/source-invite/time/reason history for plant, sending-church and Discovery subjects; do not fabricate missing legacy history. Repeated sever returns the existing/no-effect receipt and no duplicate event. Current entitlement is removed immediately for that link's bodies/results/caches while minimal allowed relationship history remains. Returning through a new ordinary approved invitation preserves history and existing per-org consent; no special rejoin restoration engine.

title: Privacy pull sharing, push consent and first-invitation defaults
behavior: Store each accepted plant/org pair's approved aggregate categories and separate activity push consent. Self-start defaults all OFF; accepted first invitation discloses active categories default ON for that exact organization, with later independent ON/OFF changes. Never reset previous consent on rejoin or another-org acceptance. Retain People/Meetings/Tasks/Teams/Wiki aggregate categories, independent activity push consent, and the existing shared_findings permission for released health/NI findings. The closed category-to-column mapping is people→share_people, meetings→share_meetings, tasks→share_tasks, ministry_teams→share_ministry_teams, wiki→share_wiki, activity→share_activity, shared_findings→shared_findings. Activity remains independently stored push consent in the same sharing command; shared_findings is one existing permission, with no second NI consent. Finance/facility/background/coach/private-care categories are absent. Missing relationship/settings fail closed. Turning a category OFF stops new reads/results/cache reuse/dispatch from it, without hiding the basic relationship directory or unaffected affiliates; coarse relationship notice must not name restricted toggle or body. Org preferences cannot authorize pull data.

title: Oversight dashboard, plant directory, consent-gated aggregates and health entry
behavior: List only current own-org related plants. Basic directory gives plant name/partial locality excluding street, attested phase/launch context, provenance and ordinary lead ministry-role Person display name (not assumed Owner); no contacts/private CRM. Aggregate sections distinguish withheld, shared-empty, shared-populated and unavailable: distinct People/status totals, recent 12 meeting cadence/attended totals, top-level actionable task counts/overdue, operational team/staffing/training coverage and Wiki reading counts. Each section uses its current consent and domain denominator; checklist/waived/cancelled tasks cannot inflate open counts. Organization intelligence/health uses its separate exact-org consent/release lineage and published-summary producer; same native/Evry bounded read. Sharing OFF/revoked affiliation removes cached/current/history body access that depends on it; unknown/foreign target is indistinguishable.

title: Network sending-church roster and member detail
behavior: Network readers list/detail only sending churches currently associated with that exact network and pending unexpired scoped relationship invitations. Member detail lists only plants that both relate to that sending church and separately have a valid same-network relationship; parent hierarchy does not manufacture plant access. Counts exclude expired/revoked invitations and foreign-network plants. Empty states explain actual scope; links go through current per-plant consent-filtered overview. Sending-church seat does not gain network roster authority.

title: Unwired organization settings, ownership transfer and account deletion boundaries
behavior: Implement the accepted target follow-through for formerly unwired organization settings: exact own sending-church/network Owner/Admin edit bounded name/contact/profile fields with protected org kind/identity, current revision and audit. No billing, ownership transfer, delete-org or wider intelligence/CRM access is implied. Personal self deletion and Owner-only church workspace deletion follow REQ-IDN-032 with explicit review, shared church history/minimal attribution and restricted native cancellation. Admin/Member/CRM lead cannot delete workspace or another login. Leaving Owner who keeps church running uses external manual exception; no claim/transfer/special rejoin UI.

title: Unused direct disassociation helpers
behavior: Uncalled direct-FK-null helpers are not separate user operations. Replace their alias semantics with the actor-bearing, typed, versioned, audited exact-link commands of IDN-021. No unguarded disassociate helper appears in the native or assistant target catalog; every relationship end shares receipt/history/notice and current entitlement removal.

title: Request boundary, CSRF exceptions, trusted routing and expired-session recovery
behavior: Cookie presence may optimize GET routing but never proves authentication. Login/session recovery remains reachable; every private route/API/action validates current session and subject. Overwrite any internal routed-URL stamp with the real URL; crawler scope is derived from real allow listed public Wiki path plus UA and returns only approved public metadata, never trusted client crawler/stamp headers. Mutating browser requests require configured canonical scheme/host/port Origin, with trusted deployment Host validation; reject missing/malformed/cross origin and HEAD/OPTIONS mutation attempts under the declared allow list. Exact independently authenticated exception routes are Resend raw-body signature webhook and sealed disable-only unsubscribe POST; GET unsubscribe is read only confirmation, wrong/expired/purpose tokens uniformly fail without mutating. Undo uses separate enable-only short proof and normal native origin. Jobs have a distinct bounded signed job end point admission, never a broad origin less prefix bypass. Safe return rejects external/protocol relative/backslash/control chars. Each admitted request still executes authoritative domain policy.

title: People directory, search, filters, cursor pagination and views
behavior: Preserve list/card/pipeline views, search of display name/email/phone, closed status/source filters and all-selected-tags AND semantics in navigable URL state. Hide retired contacts from active directory. Bound requests 1–100 with 24 row default UI pages; changing filter/search/view resets cursor while preserving sibling filters. Use deterministic createdAt +ID keyset and tenant-scoped validated cursors; invalid/foreign cursor cannot disclose rows. Treat search metacharacters literally. Inactive badges use current church-local threshold and effective confirmed-contact date, not email opens or administrative tasks. Full basic contact/address fields remain operationally available only under current tenant DTO policy.

title: Person creation, quick add, profile editing and background-check tracking
behavior: Guest minimum name with optional phone/email creates real People without fabricated surname, age/account/membership inference.

title: Person retirement and service-only restore
behavior: Use attributable soft retirement, preserving authorized CRM relations/history and private file references; remove from active queries/selectors and prevent new current references. Review actionable assigned duties and household/leadership/assignment effects before committing; unresolved work remains explicitly Needs owner rather than disappears. Native/reviewed restore rechecks tenant/revision, restores only an ordinary retired Person and recomputes current eligibility; it does not restore account seats or transfer private care. Merged sources are denied ordinary restore and routed to reviewed Unmerge. Retired history remains discoverable under current permission.

title: Account-linked contacts and recruited-contact identity
behavior: Entering a new named guest in Launch attendance creates a real People person and Launch relation together; explicit existing-person selection links that person without making a duplicate.

title: Private person photo lifecycle
behavior: Tigris private objects serve existing avatar, person-photo, commitment, generated/native-document and staged-file lifecycles. Resolve server-owned keys/versions and retain current owner/tenant/MIME/size/replacement/delete/history rules, ordinary orphan recovery and exact-reviewed Evry mutations; no new generic file framework/table.

title: Manual recruitment-stage movement, warnings, reasons and handoff
behavior: Allow all 7 closed stages, deliberate forward skips and backward moves with shown skipped-stage guidance, actor/date/reason and expected revision. Same-stage is a no-op receipt. Use one change-stage command from profile and pipeline so profile edit cannot bypass warnings. Leaving committed statuses core_group/launch_team/leader offers exact open-duty handoff to current eligible owner or explicit decline/Needs owner; no hidden partial loop. Stage change alone never withdraws commitment, changes adult classification or revokes earned training/seat. Recording interview/commitment or correction never incidentally demotes an advanced stage.

title: Recruitment pipeline grouping, ordering, inactivity and follow-up warnings
behavior: `follow_up_outcome` records contacted|attempted_no_contact|administrative_completion|no_longer_needed, actual occurredAt, immutable recordedAt/original actor, operation/obligation/task/person links and expected revision. Explicit human-confirmed contacted alone advances actual-contact freshness using occurredAt; email sent/open/click, task administrative completion, attempt or waiver supplies no contact. A contacted outcome with future/invalid time is rejected; historical late entry remains its actual occurrence. Contacted may be recorded independently from task completion when truthful, with the distinction shown. Current freshness is maximum valid effective contacted occurrence after corrections/reopen/void; removing erroneous latest evidence reveals earlier valid date rather than retaining a cached false success. Contact log renders a human-contact badge, never email delivered. Correction appends old/new/reason/actor, updates current outcome/contact projection and source revision atomically, does not resend mail or erase original receipt. Notes remain bounded operational records and cannot become private-care/model pastoral inference.

title: Activity timeline and authored-note create/edit/delete
behavior: Typed activity timeline uses event Instant+ID cursor, preserving tied timestamps and visible performer/provenance. Notes validate nonblank bounded 5000 characters; author alone edits/deletes their own note under exact Person/kind/tenant/revision. Edit preserves original occurrence and actor, appends old/new/current author/editedAt/reason correction; delete removes current note body with attributable tombstone/history subject to shared-record deletion policy. Summary profile notes remain separate fields. System audit/qualification events are not user-edit able notes. Meeting-linked note must validate actual meeting/attendance relation server-side.

title: Household lifecycle, member roles and deliberate address propagation
behavior: Tenant household name/address and head/spouse/child/other membership roles are operational facts, not adult classification. Create household+initial head coherently; join validates live same plant Person/household and copies household address only if Person lacks meaningful address. Leaving preserves Person address. Address propagation previews exact active members/current revisions and deliberately overwrites them in one bounded transaction, returning actual count. Empty-household deletion refuses active members; retired member references detach from current household while immutable old membership snapshots retain provenance. Lock Person/household consistently against retire/join/delete to avoid orphan records.

title: Church-defined tags and person assignment
behavior: Keep church-defined labels with trimmed name 1–100, optional supported named/hex color, explicit nullable clear and unique current tenant normalized name. Assignment validates live Person+tag same tenant and unique pair. Retry assign/remove writes one semantic activity or original no-op receipt, never fictitious tag event. Rename updates views/export; deletion previews linked count, removes current links and preserves attributable audit without becoming global taxonomy.

title: Skills, gifts, proficiency and category grouping
behavior: Preserve categories worship/tech/admin/teaching/hospitality/leadership/other, optional proficiency beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert, trimmed skill name 1–100 and bounded 5000 character notes. Add/edit/remove have expected revision and atomic activity/correction; category grouping and null clear roundtrip. Retire removed current item while preserving owned history. Recorded skill search/organization is allowed; it does not replace human Gifted interview criterion or infer calling/readiness.

title: SME 4 C’s assessment recording, latest result and history
behavior: Record dated human Committed/Compelled/Contagious/Courageous assessment, each integer 1–5 and optional bounded 5000 character lens notes. Compute total 4–20 server-side and enforce score/total integrity. Preserve all records, actor/occurrence date/recorded instant and latest ordering by assessment LocalDate, recordedAt, ID; late historical entry cannot become latest merely by recording time. Advisory early-stage warning is not a hard gate. Recording does not change stage. Correction is REQ-PPL-015 and never supplies model person judgment.

title: SME five-criterion interview, result, next steps and progression
behavior: Keep all five criteria Maturity/Gifted/Chemistry/Right Reasons/Season as pass/fail/concern with dated human notes, next steps and result qualified/qualified_with_notes/not_qualified/follow_up. ANY result means interview occurred; on lower earlier stage record interviewed progression atomically, while an already core_group/launch_team/leader remains advanced. Only explicit stage command demotes. Chronological latest and attributable history match assessments. Next steps remain recorded text; intended-but-undelivered automatic task prompts are not registered as automation. A user can explicitly draft/create named task through ordinary Task command.

title: Commitment recording, private document and Core Group entry
behavior: Tigris private objects serve existing avatar, person-photo, commitment, generated/native-document and staged-file lifecycles. Resolve server-owned keys/versions and retain current owner/tenant/MIME/size/replacement/delete/history rules, ordinary orphan recovery and exact-reviewed Evry mutations; no new generic file framework/table.

title: Alpha corrections of assessment, interview and commitment records
behavior: Correct exact same plant Person/record kind under current Owner/Admin and expected record revision. Reuse original domain validations; recompute assessment total, preserve original recording actor/time and append typed old/new/corrector/time/reason/receipt before commit. Ordinary score/result/notes/occurrence date correction never replays stage automation. Immutable original account/private author cannot be changed. Document/witness/original assessor replacement is outside ordinary correction fields; no arbitrary field patch or universal Undo. Use explicit new evidence record where necessary, retaining previous private document and provenance under ownership/deletion rules. Invalid historical commitment/lifecycle may be voided/corrected with attributable history and recomputed current projection, preserving earlier assessments. Stale foreign/cross-person or replayed conflicting mutation writes nothing.

title: Duplicate hints and duplicate-pair review directory
behavior: Normal duplicate candidate selection is reused; same name is never automatic merge. Repeated create/link cannot double attendance or leave a Person without its intended link on failed transaction.

title: Field-choice duplicate merge, blockers, reference transfer, receipt and redirects
behavior: Normal duplicate candidate selection is reused; same name is never automatic merge. Repeated create/link cannot double attendance or leave a Person without its intended link on failed transaction.

title: CSV template, preview, row validation, duplicate resolutions and partial import
behavior: Use RFC 4180 parser with BOM/CRLF/commas/escaped quotes/quoted multiline and explicit malformed quoting errors. Keep 12 contact input columns(first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, source, source_details, notes); normalizer/defaults match People and background fields are absent. Server limits 10 MiB/10000 rows and reparses validated original bytes/row digest, never trusts client-returned parsed rows. Preview all valid/invalid/existing and within-file duplicate rows; resolutions skip/create/create_and_review never overwrite existing Person. Save frozen reviewed row/resolution digest with import intent; per-row short transactions record created/skipped/error and optional new review pair. Retry resumes only unfinished row keys, no duplicate earlier success. Stale review/authority/digest refuses; partial import returns named row reasons and remaining work, not generic failed after commits.

title: Filtered CSV export and file serialization
behavior: Export same current filters as directory with 15 documented columns: first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, status, source, source_details, notes, tags, created_at; tags semicolon joined and recorded createdAt UTC. Header-only empty export valid. RFC 4180 escaping preserves comma/newline/quotes; spread sheet-dangerous leading=,+,-,@, TAB/CR values get documented leading apostrophe neutralization. The exact bytes are CSV notan XLSXclaim. Private photo/account/storage/qualification/background/care fields are absent. Tenant read/export authority rechecked; large exports stream/bound rows and include exact filter/count receipt. Narrow 12 column import ignores status/tags/date, so never claim lossless backup/roundtrip.

title: Recorded events and cross-domain recruitment auto-advancement
behavior:
WP-024 first supplies the minimal persistence/uniqueness API for `follow_up_obligation`, managed `task`, history/audit/receipt and source-revision changes using the caller's transaction. WP-022 depends on that kernel and owns one finalize/reconcile unit of work: lock meeting/current guest-attendance revision and affected live Persons, compute exact attended identity snapshot/classification, apply approved People attendance progression, create required first-Vision obligations plus evaluation task, record current actual Attendance/snapshot/marker and audit/receipt/material revision atomically. No after-commit task call or stub weakens this boundary. A zero-at ten dee Vision still produces evaluation work. Missing lead title/account never suppresses obligations; a currently eligible selected assignee or visible Needs owner is required. Durable review includes all generated work; invalid assignment refuses or uses explicitly reviewed unowned result.

Repeat same finalized revision returns original receipt; concurrent calls converge. Late additions/removals/same-count replacements are reconciled by identity and expected revision, not count. Corrected first-Vision eligibility may add/supersede current obligations through a reviewed delta; completed/waived/outcome history survives and no performed work is silently deleted. A removed at ten dee's unperformed obligation is marked source-corrected/no-longer-applicable with history, not successful completion. Changing current meeting date does not rewrite immutable original follow-up 48 h origin; a correction to an erroneous origin is separately reviewed with old/new metric lineage. Finalization is independent from setting meeting status completed and from practice occurrence completion. Injected failure rolls back marker+attendance effects+obligations+task+audit; response loss returns saved receipt. WP-022 proves its actual kernel consumer before closure, WP-023 later adds outcomes/contact/ownership projections; WP-056 is additional whole-target regression.

title: Deferred follow-up initiation handler and incomplete task suggestions
behavior: The uncalled deferred follow-up-initiation warning and undelivered interview next-step automatic task prompt are not executable target capabilities. Consolidate useful intent into explicit ordinary follow-up create/assign or reviewed task creation, retaining manualfollowing_up stage.
